title: Payout Management
subtitle: Review and process withdrawal requests from bidders and sellers.

modals.approveDescription: Are you sure you want to approve this payout request? This will deduct the funds from the user's locked balance.
modals.rejectDescription: Are you sure you want to reject this payout request? The locked funds will be returned to the user's available balance.

notice.title: Administrative Notice
notice.content: Approving a payout will permanently deduct the funds from the user's locked balance. Ensure the physical or external money transfer is complete before marking as Approved. Rejections will automatically release the locked funds back to the user's available balance.
